what_changed:
Search: expanded Library search with advanced options in English.
• Search field expands when activated or while entering a query
• Search settings icon appears only after activating the search field; opens a collapsible options panel
• Filter by search scope (all assets, favorites, archive), people, date range, city, and media type (photos or videos)
• Choose how Immich interprets a query: Context, File name, Description, Full path or folder, or OCR
• Context queries use visual search; file details and OCR queries use metadata search
• Combine search interpretation with filters, or search with filters alone
• Reset filters returns to the Library timeline when the query is empty

Fixes and polish:
• Ignore outdated search responses when changing queries or filters
• Keep filtered results separate from the offline Library cache
• Validate date ranges and include the entire selected end date
• Match date inputs and the settings icon to the current theme
• Preserve normal copy/paste behavior inside search options
• Add accessible labels for search settings and filter controls
• Improve messages for filter-only searches and empty results
